payload.name: Append-Only Three-Ledger Fragment Routing
payload.description: Preserve immutability and eliminate merge conflicts across concurrent flows by routing events to the three canonical JSONL stores (intents.jsonl, plans.jsonl, executions.jsonl) through per-flow pending fragments, merged readers, and deterministic promotion.

steps: Route each ledger record to its canonical store (intents.jsonl, plans.jsonl, or executions.jsonl) through sandbox_executor/ledger/route.py.
Write in-flight flow updates into isolated per-flow fragment files via sandbox_executor/ledger/fragments.py so parallel branches never contend on shared JSONL tails.
Read canonical stores and pending fragments uniformly through sandbox_executor/ledger/merged.py to present a consistent view to planners, reviewers, and calibration.
Promote completed fragments into the canonical append-only stores with sandbox_executor/ledger/promote.py and validate store invariants with scripts/check_ledger_stores.py.

known_pitfalls: Appending directly to shared canonical JSONL files from concurrent feature branches causes avoidable merge conflicts.
Reading canonical JSONL files directly without merged.py omits unpromoted in-flight fragment events.
Rewriting or deleting historical ledger lines violates the append-only immutability invariant.
